$comment: What deploy/configure.mjs generates and deploy/release.mjs deploys. `workers` is in dependency order: callees before callers (viz-ingest binds viz-publisher's Publisher class; viz-ruler calls viz-query, viz-ingest and viz-control; viz-mcp calls viz-query, viz-control and viz-ruler; viz-gateway calls all of them but viz-publisher). Promotion follows this order; rollback goes the other way. Every Durable Object class a Worker defines is declared under `schemas` (its SchemaSpec, `<path>.ts#<EXPORT>`, read into release records: contracts/COMPATIBILITY.md §6) or `unversioned` (why it keeps no storage). Every Durable Object class a Worker binds from ANOTHER Worker (by script_name) is listed under `binds_classes` as `<worker>:<class>`, with why: such a binding can call every method of every object of the class (any tenant), so configure.mjs refuses one that is not listed. A Worker that needs one question answered binds a named entrypoint of the other Worker instead (viz-mcp: viz-control's OAuthIntrospection, contracts/oauth.ts).

shared_vars.$comment: Deployment-wide values every Worker must agree on. Applied to each Worker whose own config declares the var; a differing component value is overridden and reported.

script_aliases.$comment: Names components use today for the write-path script. All of them are viz-ingest.

binds_classes.viz-publisher:Publisher: the cell's publisher, nudged by every maintenance run (D34)

binds_classes.viz-ingest:Shard: tail reads of a tenant's shards (D48)
binds_classes.viz-ingest:Ledger: the ledger's file lists for a query's range

unversioned.Leaf: keeps nothing between calls: no storage, no fields, no alarm (query/src/leaf.ts)

binds_classes.viz-control:Tenant: notificationTarget and serviceKey (contracts/control.ts, D39). Open: to become a named entrypoint of viz-control as viz-mcp's did (control/README.md, Known risks)
Tenant.provision for POST /api/v1/bootstrap only. Open: to become a named entrypoint of viz-control (control/README.md, Known risks)
